story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound date sources and populate Eligibility Date for new enrollment
gaps: Status field is "Positive" in id "TC_TS_001_002" while the test case intent is negative: "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 is rejected when Eligibility Date required for a future new enrollment is missing"

Status field is "Positive" in id "TC_TS_001_002" while Test Step Expected Result states a rejection/non-success outcome: "The transmission does not show a fully successful enrollment outcome; TM displays a rejection, validation failure, intake hold, policy unit error, or other non-success indicator tied to the malformed date content."

Status field is "Edge" in id "TC_TS_001_003" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result: "The enrollment completes successfully, the transaction effective date in Facets is 2025-01-31, no loaded transaction uses 2025-02-01 as the transaction effective date, no unexpected MELC exception row blocks the load, and the first applicable inbound date occurrence rule is fully validated."

scenarios.title: Populate Assessment Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes
gaps: Status field "Edge" for id "TC_TS002_003" has no step with an Expected Result describing an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Test Step Expected Result texts are "The mocked AR PASSE 834 file is created with active current eligibility and an unchanged Assessment Date value of 2025-06-29.", "The file is archived successfully in the AR archive location.", and "No new transaction effective-date update is created from Assessment Date logic; there is no newly created current-eligibility transaction effective date change driven by the unchanged Assessment Date value."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date and preserve relevant fields when only Assessment Date changes
Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility change when relevant fields change and Assessment Date does not
gaps: Status field 'Edge' for id 'TC_TS004_003' has no step whose Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Examples from Test Step Expected Result include 'The file is saved with a future Eligibility Date but no actual change to the relevant field value or Assessment Date.' and 'The transaction is either ignored or completed without creating a member-data change, and TM shows no applied update for Assessment Tier because the submitted value matches the current stored value.'

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date only for current eligibility change when relevant fields change and Assessment Date does not
Regression guard that Maintenance Date is not used outside specified scenarios
gaps: Status field for id TC_TS007_003 is "Edge" but no Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Examples from Test Step Expected Result include "The file reaches a completed processing state without FXI error and without policy unit failure, establishing that any absent split is due to logic behavior rather than a rejected file." and "No extra 2026-06-20 eligibility row is created; the absent maintenance-date split is confirmed by an unchanged count for 2026-06-20 rows after processing."
